description: Apply the safe fixes to a request body or source code passed as text, and return the mended text with how many findings were mended and the report of what is left. A safe fix only mends what the API would refuse: a criteria key written yes where it takes true, a mistyped question type, criteria in the wrong shape. A fix that changes what a working request does, such as adding a fallback option or pinning a model, is never applied here. It stays in the report with its edit marked safe: false, for you to make or to leave. Nothing is written to disk and nothing is sent over the network.

filename.description: A file name whose extension says what the text is: .json, .ts, .js, .py, .rs or .go. Defaults to request.jev.json.

rules.description: Rule levels to override, such as { "DEC004": "off" }. Levels: off, hint, info, warning, error.

text.description: The request JSON or the source code.

name: fix_text

docs.description: The vendor page behind the rule.

endColumn.description: One-based column just past where it ends.

fix.description: The edit the linter would make, or null when the change is yours to make. Safe when it only mends what the API would refuse, so fix_text applies it unasked. Otherwise it changes what a working request does, and is left to you.

endColumn.description: One-based column just past where it ends.

text.description: What replaces the text between the positions.

questionId.description: The question the finding is about, when it has an id.

unreadableCount.description: Questions with a part built at runtime, which no rule could read in full.

text.description: The text with the safe fixes applied.

excluded.description: Files a settings file leaves out.

jev.description: What was sent to the model, or under plan_ask what would be. Present only on those calls.

answerer.description: What answers, as the messages name it: Jev, Luna or the model.

estimatedInputTokens.description: A rough estimate made before sending, meant to err high. What the platform bills can differ.

overLimit.description: Requests left out for being past maxCalls.

runtime.description: Questions with a part built at runtime, which the model is never shown.

sent.description: False when the call only planned.

state.description: True when state written in the text was sent, or would be.

vendor.description: Who was sent the requests, or would be.

skipped.description: Files over the size limit, not read.

unread.description: Folders and files that could not be read.

title: Fix text
